power.description: Active power (W) or apparent power (VA) -- which one is declared by power_type. Dimensionally identical in the underlying units engine; the label is what carries the engineering meaning.

voltage.description: Single-phase: the system voltage. Three-phase: line-to-line voltage.

power_factor.description: Required when power_type is 'active'; not accepted when power_type is 'apparent' (see validation.py).

efficiency.description: Divides the given power to obtain the actual electrical power drawn from the supply (e.g. a motor's rated mechanical output vs. its electrical input). Defaults to 1.0 (no loss).
